purpose: Sequential monitoring acceptance and related regression only

acceptance_bounds.stop: known terminal, explicit stop/cap, or deterministic injected error

regression_bounds.ctest: existing 91 tests; bounded test-owned games, existing profile <=200 placements; PUCT tests <=32 simulations
regression_bounds.optional_puct_budget: 3 simulations twice, no actual board application
regression_bounds.skipped_learning: No train/resume or overfit/update tests; no new SL authorized

persistence: Each scenario creates an independent output before execution; temporary test directories only; production checkpoints are read/copied and hash-checked

cli_smoke.stop: runner cap or earlier actual terminal
